notes.title: Littlstar VR Cinema v2.10 Release
notes.content:
We're excited to release v2.10 of Littlstar VR Cinema today, complete with a new interface and content!

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Complete redesign of VR Cinema
[*]Extended [url=lstar.co/pcsideloading]sideloading support[/url]
[*]Rift Touch support
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy Littlstar VR Cinema, and as always, reach out to support@littlstar.com for any help or suggestions!

notes.title: Littlstar VR Cinema v2.01 Release - Oculus Rift Support
notes.content:
We now support Oculus Rift on Steam! We hope you enjoy! 

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Oculus Rift support (w/ XBox Controller)
[*]Korean, Chinese (Traditional), and Russian localization
[*]Video load cancelling and better error handling
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy Littlstar VR Cinema, and as always, reach out to support@littlstar.com for any help or suggestions!
